meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为作品添加品牌色彩与排版风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容快速应用品牌视觉规范。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your artifacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual guidelines to your content.

howto.what: Claude 会把 Anthropic 官方品牌配色（深色、浅色、灰阶与橙蓝绿强调色）和字体（标题 Poppins、正文 Lora）应用到它生成的幻灯片等产物上，字体缺失时回退 Arial/Georgia。
howto.when: 当你需要产物套用 Anthropic 品牌配色、视觉格式或公司设计规范时触发。

say.text: 用 Anthropic 品牌配色把这份内容做成幻灯片
say.note: 会套用品牌颜色和字体

say.text: 把标题改成 Poppins、正文改成 Lora
say.note: 按品牌排版规则设置字体

say.text: 给这个图表配上品牌强调色
say.note: 非文字形状轮换橙、蓝、绿

howto.what_en: Claude applies Anthropic's official brand colors (dark, light, grays plus orange, blue and green accents) and fonts (Poppins headings, Lora body) to artifacts it produces, falling back to Arial and Georgia when those fonts are missing.
howto.when_en: Use it when brand colors, style guidelines, visual formatting or company design standards apply to the artifact you are making.
